result.topic_en: Determining the place of the Moon's node and correcting the lunar node tables from the duration of a lunar eclipse, using the spherical triangle formed by the node, the shadow centre and the Moon's centre, and deriving a formula for tang(2x − c).
result.transcription:
De loco lunae ex eclipsibus lunaribus determinando. 371

[...] tantum in aliquot minutis secundis consistunt, nimis anxii esse vellemus. Praeterea [...] determinatione commode evenit, ut tempus durationis eclipsis, quo luna arcum [...], nempe littera $h$ ex calculo excesserit; sicque patet eandem operationem locum habere, [...] momentum medium collectum sit ex initio et fine eclipsis, sive ex immersione et emersione, [...] ex aequalibus lunae phasibus, quibus arcus $LS$ et $ls$ inter se sint aequales. Omnes [...] hujusmodi observationes, si exacte instituantur, idem eclipsis momentum medium praebere [...]

§. 16. Tempus autem, quo arcus $Ll$ et $Ss$ percurruntur, una cum arcuum $LS$ et $ls$ magnitu[...] inserviet loco nodi propius cognoscendo, sicque tabula nodorum lunae inde emendari poterit, [...] correctione indigeat. Cum enim arcus $SL$ et $sl$ sint aequales, et ex diametris apparentibus [...] lunae satis exacte dentur, sit uterque arcus $SL = sl = f$. Tum vero sit in medio eclip[...] umbrae in $\sigma$, et centrum lunae in $\lambda$, ac ponantur arcus $☊\sigma = x$, et $☊\lambda = y$, erit
$[x-]y = U - L = \frac{(m+n+2k)\sin 2x \tang^2 \frac{1}{2}\varrho}{g(n-m)}$, hocque ergo discrimen, ob $\sin 2x$ et $\tang \frac{1}{2}\varrho$ proxime [...], cum sit minimum, pro dato haberi poterit. Sit intervallum temporis ab $L$ ad $l = h$ hora[...] eruntque arcus $L\lambda = l\lambda = \frac{1}{2}h(n+k)''$ et $S\sigma = \sigma s = \frac{1}{2}h(m+k)''$. Ideoque habebitur
$☊L = y - \frac{1}{2}h(n+k)'' = x - \frac{1}{2}h(n+k)'' - \frac{(m+n+2k)\sin 2x \tang^2 \frac{1}{2}\varrho}{g(n-m)}$ et $☊S = x - \frac{1}{2}h(m+k)''$.

§. 17. Ponamus brevitatis gratia
$\frac{1}{2}h(n+k) = a, \quad \frac{(m+n+2k)\sin 2x \tang^2 \frac{1}{2}\varrho}{g(n-m)} = c \quad \text{et} \quad \frac{1}{2}h(m+k) = b$
[...] sint in triangulo sphaerico $S☊L$ latera $☊L = x - a - c$, $☊S = x - b$, $SL = f$ et ang. $☊ = \varrho$;
[...] reperietur
$\cos f = \cos\varrho \sin(x-a-c)\sin(x-b) + \cos(x-a-c)\cos(x-b)$
[...] eruetur
$\cos(2x-a-b-c) = \frac{\cos f - \cos^2\frac{1}{2}\varrho \cos(a-b+c)}{\sin^2\frac{1}{2}\varrho}$.
[...] autem aequatione, quoniam levis error in angulo $\varrho$ commissus fit admodum notabilis, angu[...] $2x - a - b - c$ non satis exacte inveniri potest. Cum igitur, si triangulum $l☊s$ consideretur, [...] hanc perveniatur aequationem
$\cos(2x+a+b-c) = \frac{\cos f - \cos^2\frac{1}{2}\varrho \cos(a-b-c)}{\sin^2\frac{1}{2}\varrho}$
[...] illam aequationem per hanc dividendo
$\frac{\cos(a+b) + \sin(a+b)\tang(2x-c)}{\cos(a+b) - \sin(a+b)\tang(2x-c)} = \frac{\cos f - \cos^2\frac{1}{2}\varrho \cos(a-b+c)}{\cos f - \cos^2\frac{1}{2}\varrho \cos(a-b-c)}$
seu $\tang(2x-c) = \frac{\sin(a-b)\cos(a+b)\sin c \cos^2\frac{1}{2}\varrho}{\sin(a+b)\cos f - \sin(a+b)\cos(a-b)\cos c \cos^2\frac{1}{2}\varrho}$.

§. 18. Quamquam autem hic error in angulo $\varrho$ in cosinu$^2 \frac{1}{2}\varrho$ fit plane imperceptibilis, tamen [...] minimus error in angulo $c$ commissus inventionem anguli $2x - c$ nimis incertam reddit, ita

items.quote: Omnes [...] hujusmodi observationes, si exacte instituantur, idem eclipsis momentum medium praebere [...]
items.english: All observations of this kind, if made exactly, [should] give the same mean moment of the eclipse.

items.quote: Tempus autem, quo arcus $Ll$ et $Ss$ percurruntur, una cum arcuum $LS$ et $ls$ magnitu[...] inserviet loco nodi propius cognoscendo, sicque tabula nodorum lunae inde emendari poterit
items.english: The time in which the arcs Ll and Ss are traversed, together with the magnitudes of the arcs LS and ls, will serve to determine the place of the node more closely, and thus the table of the Moon's nodes can be corrected from it.

items.quote: quoniam levis error in angulo $\varrho$ commissus fit admodum notabilis, angu[...] $2x - a - b - c$ non satis exacte inveniri potest
items.english: Since a slight error committed in the angle ρ becomes quite noticeable, the angle 2x − a − b − c cannot be found exactly enough.

items.quote: minimus error in angulo $c$ commissus inventionem anguli $2x - c$ nimis incertam reddit
items.english: The smallest error committed in the angle c renders the determination of the angle 2x − c too uncertain.
